notes.title: Release Date Confirmed for The Scroll of Taiwu: Beyond The Dome English Complete
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, The Scroll of Taiwu will officially conclude its Early Access phase during Chinese New Year 2026 with the release of the English Complete Edition, The Scroll of Taiwu: Beyond The Dome. In this Complete Edition, we will introduce three brand-new storylines, an all-new UI, an improved tutorial, and a wealth of gameplay enhancements/optimizations. Stay tuned!
